question: Should this credential-boundary change require a redacted live assist publication and retry demonstration before merge?
rationale: Source inspection and unit tests cannot establish the effective GitHub Actions token scopes, artifact transfer, and resulting GitHub comment behavior.

options.title: Require live workflow proof
options.body: Require redacted exact-head generation and publisher logs, the resulting comment, and a repeat request showing exactly one marker-backed comment.

options.title: Accept source-only assurance
options.body: Merge while explicitly accepting the remaining uncertainty in the live Actions permission and artifact path.

recommendation.title: Require live workflow proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted exact-head generation and publisher logs, the resulting comment, and a repeat request showing exactly one marker-backed comment.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the assist workflow on current main.
